FOUR ALTERNATIVES. FOUR DIFFERENT REASONS.

Easy Appointment Booking alternatives.
Keep the class. Rework the overhead.

Easy Appointment Booking is built around services and events, with packs, waitlists and deposits on Pro Plus. The choice of an alternative often turns on two expenses beyond the entry price: the tier for advanced marketing and the cost of staff logins.

What would make switching worthwhile?

Easy Appointment Booking can be a good fit for an event-led business, particularly when its packs, waitlists and staff workflow match your operation. Confirm the relevant plan before replacing it.

YOUR DECISION STARTS HERE

The differences that matter for Easy Appointment Booking users.

01

An event team, not just a calendar

Compare attendee handling, packs, waitlists and booking changes. Pro Plus is $39/month in the checked listing.

02

Staff access

The listing mentions $8 per staff login. Confirm who needs independent access and whether a quoted allowance includes those users.

03

Klaviyo and Shopify Flow

The listing mentions an Ultimate upgrade at $99/month. A comparison with the $15 Standard tier would miss that requirement.

YOUR MIGRATION CHECKLIST

Test the reason you are switching.

  1. Test a class with multiple attendees Check quantity, attendee details, waitlist behavior and a cancelled place. Preserve what the instructor needs on the day.
  2. Budget the people doing the work List each staff member who needs a login. Ask how access, permissions and additional users are billed.
  3. Move active packs deliberately Reconcile unused sessions, upcoming bookings and customer instructions before changing the booking links.

Easy Appointment Booking alternatives: common questions.

Which Easy Appointment Booking tier supports packs and deposits?

The checked listing places booking packs, waitlists and deposits on Pro Plus at $39/month.

What extra costs should I compare?

Check staff logins, the plan for Klaviyo or Shopify Flow, and optional messaging. The listing mentions $8 per staff login and an Ultimate upgrade at $99/month.
